headline: Review of a proposed artificial intelligence and emerging technologies policy, and recommended changes to Sections J and K.
summary: A proposed policy on artificial intelligence and emerging technologies will be reviewed. Recommendations for Sections J and K will also be reviewed and approved, with changes.

Review and approval of recommendations for Section J, with changes
